enrichment_rows.auto_detection_policy: When --enrichment-rows is omitted, the runner uses the first existing default row path candidate and records it in row_input_resolution.

numeric_value_policy.score: must parse to a finite float; NaN and Infinity are rejected

row_integrity_policy.purpose: Duplicate enrichment targets or scored molecules cannot be used to inflate Public Benchmark enrichment coverage or active/decoy counts.

score_direction_policy.blank_values: rejected; no implicit default is applied

gpcr_rows.claim_boundary: GPCR Phase 3 actual closure requires operator-attached raw hard-decoy ranking rows for every required target plus a verifiable source receipt. Summary metrics or fixture rows do not satisfy actual closure.

numeric_value_policy.score: must parse to a finite float; NaN and Infinity are rejected

row_integrity_policy.purpose: Duplicate molecules within a GPCR target cannot be used to inflate positive/decoy counts or Phase 3 hard-decoy ranking metrics.

gpcr_rows.score_direction_policy: Each target must use one consistent score_direction value; mixed higher_is_better/lower_is_better rows for the same target are rejected.

source_actuality_policy.source_artifact_sha256_policy: sha256:<64 hex> and must match the attached raw hard-decoy row artifact

gpcr_rows.unexpected_target_policy: Rows for targets outside the required DRD2/HTR2A/OPRM1 set are recorded as unexpected_targets and do not count toward actual closure.

boolean_value_policy.local_min_survived: must parse to a boolean value

pocketmd_rows.claim_boundary: PocketMD Lite closure is limited to top-k local refinement rows with local-min survival, contact persistence, H-bond persistence, clash relief, and uncertainty summaries. It does not unlock broad all-atom MD, FEP, long-timescale dynamics, or de novo binding claims.

integer_value_policy.clash_count_after: must parse to a non-negative integer
integer_value_policy.clash_count_before: must parse to a non-negative integer

numeric_value_policy.h_bond_persistence_rate: must parse to a finite float in [0, 1]; NaN and Infinity are rejected

numeric_value_policy.pre_refinement_energy_proxy: must parse to a finite float; NaN and Infinity are rejected

numeric_value_policy.uncertainty_interval.low: must parse to a finite float; NaN and Infinity are rejected

pocketmd_rows.top_k_rank_prefix_policy: For each case, supplied ranks must form a contiguous prefix starting at rank 1; cherry-picked gaps are not valid top-k refinement input.
